_comment: Structured facts for the 3 hackathon demo/judge accounts (docs/DEMO_ACCOUNTS.md). Loaded by scripts/seed_demo_accounts.py. No secrets. Taste names are chosen from functions/bootstrap/qloo_fixture.json so the good/bad split is reproducible on both the offline fixture and live Qloo. test1xtest2 share the folk/indie cluster (HIGH); test3 is jazz/sci-fi (LOW). Match: all three are Long-term (so they share the long_term branch and surface in Explore); test1 & test2 answer identically (no gate -> high); test3 clashes on procreation_intent with test1 (one gate -> capped <=25 -> low).

personas.name: Daniel Reyes
personas.headline: UX designer, weekend potter, folk-show regular
personas.brief: Daniel Reyes, 29, a UX designer at a small product studio in San Jose. Warm, bookish and a little introverted; he recharges on long trail runs in the East Bay hills and at a neighborhood pottery studio where he throws mugs most Sundays. Grew up in San Jose in a close Mexican-American family; first in his family to finish grad school. Values honesty, slowness and craft. Looking for a long-term partner to build a quiet, creative life with. Reads a lot of fiction, cooks from scratch, and plans his weekends around small folk shows. Secure, gentle in conflict, wants kids in the next few years.

personas.name: Sofia Marino
personas.headline: Ceramic artist & art teacher who lives for folk harmonies
personas.brief: Sofia Marino, 27, a ceramic artist who also teaches an after-school art class in San Jose. Warm, unhurried and quietly funny; she spends weekends at her studio, at farmers markets, and at the same small folk shows Daniel loves. Italian-American, grew up in the Bay, close to her family but building her own independent life. Values craft, honesty and slow mornings with good coffee and a good record. Looking for a long-term partner to make a creative, grounded home with, and wants kids in the next few years. Secure, talks things through, warm but not clingy.

personas.name: Priya Nair
personas.headline: Investment analyst, jazz-club regular, built for the fast lane
personas.brief: Priya Nair, 30, an investment analyst at a finance firm in San Jose. Sharp, ambitious and high-energy; she travels constantly for work, trains hard at the gym, and unwinds at late jazz sets and new fine-dining spots. South-Asian American, fiercely independent, firmly childfree and building toward early financial independence. Loves a good debate, keeps her life streamlined and her accounts separate. Dates with intention but on no fixed timeline, and values ambition and autonomy over a slow domestic life.
